tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last canvas history step for the required canvasId. Activates that loaded tab, uses the editor's own history action and saves the result. Returns applied=false if no history action is available. Only use at the user's request; history may include manual user edits. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone canvas history step for the required canvasId. Activates that loaded tab, uses the editor's own history action and saves the result. Returns applied=false if no history action is available. Only use at the user's request; history may include manual user edits. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: get_canvas
tools.description: Read a loaded canvas by canvasId, or omit canvasId to read the active canvas, including its canvasId, full elements, selected elements and bounds. Explicit IDs can read loaded background tabs without switching tabs. Read before editing. Coordinates are scene pixels, angles are radians. No separate AI API key is needed. Use get_workspace when no canvas is active. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: add_elements
tools.description: Create up to 500 elements with NEW unique IDs in the required canvasId, including a loaded background tab without switching tabs. Required element fields: id,type,x,y,width,height. For text also provide text and preferably fontSize (default 20); width/height must fit it. A box label is a separate text element, optionally linked via containerId/boundElements. Arrow points are relative to x/y, e.g. [[0,0],[180,0]]. Do not overwrite existing IDs. Call fit_canvas with the same canvasId after drawing. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: update_elements
tools.description: Patch existing elements by ID in the required canvasId, including a loaded background tab without switching tabs. Only send changed supported fields (position, size, text, colors, etc). Element types cannot change. Returns updated and notFound IDs. Read get_canvas with the same canvasId first. Text updates should include appropriate width/height. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete the specified IDs from the required canvasId, including a loaded background tab without switching tabs; bound labels are also removed. Returns deleted and notFound IDs. Read get_canvas with the same canvasId first and only delete what the user requested. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: fit_canvas
tools.description: Pan/zoom the required canvasId to fit all elements, or only the supplied IDs. Supports loaded background tabs without switching tabs. Call after creating a diagram; use open_canvas if the user wants to activate its tab. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

canvasId.description: Explicit canvas identity: projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw (at most 2100 characters). Use an ID returned by the app; the target must be a loaded tab.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Read the desktop workspace, even when no canvas is active or playback is running. Returns projects, projectId, activeCanvasId, presenting and canvases [{canvasId,projectId,path,status}]. Discover explicit project and loaded canvas identities before operating. When presenting is true, ask the user to exit playback before other operations.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the desktop workspace projects and their IDs. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an existing local directory as a project. directory must be an absolute directory path. Read get_workspace afterward to inspect the selected project and loaded tabs. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories in the specified project. Paths are relative to the project directory. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: get_presentation
tools.description: Read project presentation metadata: {decks,areas}. Decks map folder paths (empty string for project root) to {order,includeSubfolders}; areas map .excalidraw paths to {x,y,width,height} in scene pixels. Read before set_presentation and preserve unrelated settings. Does not start playback. Unavailable during playback; get_workspace remains available.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: set_presentation
tools.description: Replace only the project presentation metadata with {decks,areas}; never edits canvas elements. Read get_presentation first and merge unrelated entries. Deck order uses project-relative .excalidraw paths; eligible unlisted files follow in natural filename order, filtered by includeSubfolders. Area rectangles use finite scene coordinates and positive dimensions; omit an area to restore full content bounds. Native validation enforces safe paths, extensions, 4096-byte paths, 5000 decks/areas, 25000 total order entries and coordinate magnitude at most 1e9. Returns saved=true. No playback start/stop or annotation tool; user controls playback in the app. Rejected during playback.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

decks.description: Folder settings keyed by project-relative folder path; the empty key means the project root. Order entries are project-relative .excalidraw paths.

areas.description: Playback rectangles in scene pixels keyed by project-relative .excalidraw path; omit a key to use full content bounds.

tools.name: create_canvas
tools.description: Create a new .excalidraw file at a project-relative path and open its tab. Returns canvasId. Use an unused path and create any missing parent directories first. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: open_canvas
tools.description: Open an existing project-relative .excalidraw file and activate its tab. Returns canvasId; use that explicit ID for subsequent canvas operations. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Rename or move a file or directory within a project using relative from/to paths. Associated conversations move with it. Canvas identities change with their paths; read get_workspace and list_files afterward before using new canvasIds. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

from.description: Project-relative file or directory path, with / separators; no absolute paths or . / .. segments.

to.description: Project-relative file or directory path, with / separators; no absolute paths or . / .. segments.

tools.name: duplicate_canvas
tools.description: Duplicate an existing .excalidraw file within a project using relative from/to paths. Use an unused destination; read list_files afterward and open_canvas when the copy needs editing. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory at a project-relative path. Its parent directory must already exist; create nested directories one level at a time. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

path.description: Project-relative file or directory path, with / separators; no absolute paths or . / .. segments.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Move a real project file or directory to the system Trash. Deleting a directory includes ALL files inside it, not just canvases. Inspect list_files first and delete only the scope requested by the user. Read get_workspace and list_files afterward. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

path.description: Project-relative file or directory path, with / separators; no absolute paths or . / .. segments.

tools.name: reveal_file
tools.description: Reveal a project-relative file or directory in the system file manager. Omit path to reveal the project directory. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

path.description: Project-relative file or directory path, with / separators; no absolute paths or . / .. segments.

tools.name: get_project_resources
tools.description: Read project-first Skill/MCP metadata, confirmed memory and restrictive policy. Does not expose credentials. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: read_agent_file
tools.description: Preview a scoped .agents Skill/resource/memory file and its revision before proposing or saving changes. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

path.description: Exact file path returned by get_project_resources, including approved global-skill:// references.

tools.name: write_skill
tools.description: Save a Skill package only inside the project of an active in-app Agent run whose user requested Skill creation or optimization. Read the current package revision before updating; use null for creation. Returns verified file artifacts; a canvas diagram alone is not a saved Skill. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

path.description: Project-relative file or directory path, with / separators; no absolute paths or . / .. segments.

tools.name: request_user_input
tools.description: For an active in-app run, show a real input request in the conversation and wait for the human response. Shapes and canvas labels are not approval. Do not request routine confirmations for authorized drawing. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: remember_project_fact
tools.description: Propose a durable project fact. The app asks the human to confirm this exact content before writing .agents/memory. Requires an active in-app run. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Record a short task plan for a complex active in-app run. Simple explanations, direct drawing and selected edits do not require planning. Unavailable during playback; check get_workspace.presenting and ask the user to exit first.

projectId.description: Project UUID returned by get_workspace, list_projects or open_project.

instructions: Operate the running local AI Excalidraw desktop app 0.5.0 through 26 tools. Read get_workspace to discover projects, loaded canvases and presenting. Use the editable canvas to show useful comparisons, plans, workflows and results; refer to labelled options in chat and read fresh canvas/selection feedback on the next turn. Direct drawing requests and explicit edits to selected elements should still be performed directly. Selection alone is reference context, not approval; ordinary shapes do not submit forms or execute actions. When creating or improving a Skill, consider visualizing its workflow and changes and incorporating appropriate canvas feedback into its instructions. Skill source belongs in the current project .agents/skills when file permissions allow; canvas diagrams do not mean a Skill file was saved or installed. During playback only get_workspace is available; ask the user to exit before other operations. get_presentation reads and set_presentation replaces only presentation metadata; read and merge existing decks/areas first. Playback of canvas files or folders and temporary annotations are controlled by the user in the app; annotations last until exit and are not canvas edits. No start/stop playback tool exists. Canvas IDs are projectUUID:relative/path.excalidraw, at most 2100 characters. Only get_canvas may omit canvasId to use the active canvas; all six other canvas tools require it. Loaded background tabs can be targeted without switching tabs, except undo/redo activate the target tab. Read the target canvas before editing and preserve unrelated elements. On timeout, save failure or conflict, read get_workspace/list_files and the affected get_canvas or get_presentation before deciding what to do; never blindly retry a mutation, which may already have applied.
